name: Sorry
summary: Sorry's Status Page plan costs US$99 a month, billed monthly, and includes 1,000 subscribers and 5 team members. Enterprise pricing is given after a demo. A 7-day trial needs no card, and there is no free plan.

facts.text: Each subscriber has one profile tied to an email address and chooses channels and components, with email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat and SMS listed as notification options.
The sample page shows a Past 30 days uptime view per component, with figures such as 99.95%.
Planned maintenance notices can be scheduled in advance.
Team member single sign-on with any SAML provider and role-based access control are listed on the Status Page plan.

plans.name: Status Page
plans.notes: 1,000 subscribers, 5 team members, custom domain, REST API. The page offers monthly or yearly payment but lists no yearly price.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom arrangements handled through a demo request

hiddenCosts: Extra team members cost from $5 a month each.
Private status pages and multiple status pages are add-ons with no price shown.
